items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And I had a cousin, Estee Bijou, and you mentioned relatives...

ctx.x: Never went on the TOBA circuit, which was the Black ...(?)... attraction. It was Tough On Black Asses; that was the name of TOBA. It started at the Pekin Theatre and went down South.
And I had a cousin, Estee Bijou, and you mentioned relatives...
